data.body: AC amendment (gap-analysis: implicit_assumption): Pin finding_hash algorithm to sha256 hex digest, NOT Python builtin hash() (which is per-process randomized via PYTHONHASHSEED — would silently break local/CI parity). Specification: finding_hash returns hashlib.sha256(f'{file}|{line_range}|{category}'.encode('utf-8')).hexdigest()[:16]. Normalize line_range to canonical string form: tuples/lists [start, end] → 'start-end'; int → 'int'; existing string → unchanged. Add test: assert subprocess.run twice produces identical hashes; assert finding_hash({'line_range': '12-15'}) == finding_hash({'line_range': [12, 15]}) == finding_hash({'line_range': (12, 15)}).
